$comment: Headerless pipe-delimited source: Spark names the columns _c0.._cN positionally, so source_name is the ORDINAL, not a name from the file. Verified against the real sample file's field count -- a mismatch is a hard error at ingest (schema_config.py raises when a source_name is absent), which is the intended behaviour: a source that changed shape must fail loudly, not land misaligned columns. Field count: 47. Only the fields UC6 actually consumes are named; the rest are retained positionally rather than dropped, so a later requirement can name one without re-ingesting.
